tasks.title: Replace dynamic execution with a parser in lib/calc.mjs
tasks.intent: Rewrite lib/calc.mjs as a tokenizer plus recursive-descent parser: skip spaces; tokens are + - * / ( ) and integer literals; grammar expr := term (('+'|'-') term)*, term := factor (('*'|'/') factor)*, factor := integer | '(' expr ')' | '-' factor. Conventional precedence and left associativity, true division quotient, and a thrown Error on malformed input (trailing tokens, unbalanced parens, unknown characters). The rewritten file must contain no dynamic-execution API references at all, including inside comments, to satisfy the SEC-C01-A not-contains check.

tasks.title: Extend calc tests for parser behavior and static safety
tasks.intent: Extend tests/calc.test.mjs (existing arithmetic test untouched) with: spaces ignored, parentheses overriding precedence, nested parentheses, left-associative subtraction, true division (7/2 → 3.5), unary minus, throws on invalid input ("2+", "foo", unbalanced parens, adjacent numbers), and a static source check that lib/calc.mjs contains neither forbidden API name — pinning SEC-C01 as executable test evidence in addition to the file acceptance.

tasks.title: Run suite and file acceptance
tasks.intent: Execute SEC-001-A (node --test "tests/*.test.mjs", exit 0) and SEC-C01-A (lib/calc.mjs does not contain the forbidden call syntax), giving both must properties an executed verification path.

observations.statement: lib/calc.mjs currently delegates to the global dynamic-execution API, which executes arbitrary input strings; any replacement must parse arithmetic structurally instead, and the file text (including comments) must avoid the forbidden substrings so the SEC-C01-A notContains check passes.
The pre-existing test calc("2+3*4") === 14 pins conventional precedence (* before +); the parser grammar must reproduce that, and the test must keep passing untouched.
